show_description: Weekly sermons brought to you by Revelation Church London. To find out more about who we are, go to www.revelationchurch.org.uk or say hello to us at hello@revelationchurch.org.uk.  Revelation Church is a young, vibrant and diverse church in Camden, with a vision to see the gospel of Jesus succeed in the lives of 21st century Londoners, to build those Londoners into a Christ-centred community and to send them back into their worlds, equipped in the power of the Holy Spirit.
